title: Absence Deduction Rule Details — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: One step of a sick leave deduction scale. Payroll counts the employee's sick days through the cycle; each day takes the first step whose Days Count reaches that day's number, and is paid at 100% less that step's deduction. Sick days beyond the last step are not paid at all, so make the last step reach as far as sick leave can run.

fields.label: AbsenceDeductionRules
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Absence Deduction Rule master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The scale this step belongs to.

Example. Kuwait Sick Leave Scale

fields.label: StartDate
fields.html: What it is. The first day this record applies.

fields.label: EndDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Cannot be before the start date.
fields.html: What it is. The last day this record applies.

fields.label: DaysCount
fields.html:
What it is. The sick day, counted through the cycle, up to which this step applies.

Example. 25 — days 16 to 25, after a first step of 15.

Why it matters. Steps are read in order of this number.

fields.label: DeductionUnit
fields.html:
What it is. Whether the deduction is a percentage or a fixed amount.

Why it matters. Not read at present: the deduction number is always treated as a percentage.

fields.label: DeductionNumber
fields.html:
What it is. The percentage of a day's pay taken off for sick days in this step.

Example. 25 — each day paid at 75%.
